spacing_and_layout.containers: p-6 or p-8 internal padding for cards
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid #2A2A2D for cards and inputs, no heavy drop shadows
spacing_and_layout.radii: rounded-lg (8px) or rounded-2xl (16px) maximum for subtle softness, avoiding pill shapes
spacing_and_layout.client_app_layout: Vertical scroll, stacked cards, sticky bottom bar for booking summary (price/duration sum).
spacing_and_layout.admin_layout: Bento grid for dashboard overview, compact tables for lists.

components.buttons: Flat design, primary color #C5A880 with black text. Hover state slightly lighter. Use Framer Motion for tap scale (0.98).
components.inputs: Shadcn input customized: bg-[#141416], border-[#2A2A2D], focus:ring-[#C5A880], text-white.
components.cards: Cardless or 1px border. bg-[#141416]. Hover: border-[#C5A880]/50 transition-colors.
components.bottom_sheet: For mobile confirmation/summary, use a drawer/bottom sheet with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10.
components.calendar: Custom horizontal scroll for dates on mobile, bento grid of time slots.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up (y: 10 -> 0) using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.list_stagger: Stagger children for service list appearance.
motion_and_interactions.active_state: Selected services/slots get a soft #C5A880 glow or 1px solid #C5A880 border with subtle bg tint.

assets.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Thin or Light weight for elegant feel)

technical_requirements.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
technical_requirements.state_management: Client app must track selected_services, total_duration, total_price, selected_worker ('anyone' by default), selected_datetime.
technical_requirements.admin_features: Timeline view, Employee CRUD (hours, breaks), Service CRUD, Advance Payment toggle per booking, Phone Blacklist button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with the provided color palette, matching Shadcn UI structure.
Implement the font links for Cormorant Garamond and Outfit in index.html/layout.
Build a mobile-first wizard for the client booking flow. Step 1: Services (sum duration), Step 2: Worker (or Anyone), Step 3: Date/Time (based on duration), Step 4: Details (Name/Phone) & Confirm.
Implement the Admin Dashboard using a Bento Grid approach for today's timeline.
Ensure 'Advance payment' feature is a boolean flag on the reservation model, toggleable by admin.
Implement 'Blacklist' by adding a 'blacklisted_phones' table/collection, checked during booking creation.
Implement daily limit: Count reservations by phone number for the given date, reject if >= 3.
Use Phosphor icons with `weight="light"` for an elegant look.
DO NOT use Inter font. Use Outfit for sans-serif.
Apply data-testid to all buttons, list items, inputs, and form submissions.
